2. `liongard_launchpoint LIST` for the environment with inspector ID 29. One report section per system found; if none, say so and stop. Record `latestInspectionDate` for each.
3. This card continues in 5 more files. Before fetching anything, run one knowledge search for each of these exact phrases and read every result: "single-system-watchguard run card part 2"; "single-system-watchguard run card part 3"; "single-system-watchguard run card part 4"; "single-system-watchguard run card part 5"; "single-system-watchguard run card part 6". If you run out of searches before every part is read, do not skip those metrics and do not stop silently: evaluate the parts you have, list the unread parts, and end the turn with "Reply continue to evaluate the remaining parts." When the user replies continue, search only the unread parts, evaluate them, and give the complete report. Then confirm you can see all 29 metric lines (P001 to P029). Retrieval returns only part of this card: if any sequence id is missing, search the knowledge again for the heading of the missing group (for example "single-system-watchguard metrics P013-P018") until every line is found. Never skip a metric because its line was not retrieved.
4. For every metric line below, call `liongard_metric EVALUATE` with `metricId`, `systemId`, `environmentId`: this returns the value Liongard already stored, so write no query. If that call returns no data rows at all (the metric is not stored on this instance) or has no metricId, do not retry the stored call: immediately call `liongard_metric EVALUATE` once with `jmesPathQuery` set to that line's fallback query exactly as written on that metric's own `fallback query` line. Operator words in fallback queries: knowledge storage corrupts the symbols, so before sending, replace each EQ_OP with two equals characters in a row and each AND_OP with two ampersand characters in a row and each OR_OP with two vertical-bar characters in a row, changing nothing else. An empty array, an empty string or 0 is a real value, not "No data": report it as such. Only a null, an error, or no rows after the fallback is "No data".
5. Run exactly these metric lines: no extra metrics, no `liongard_metric LIST`, no invented paths or sequence numbers.
6. Write the report in the report format below, apply the QA and rendering rules from the agent instructions, and end with Manual Verification Needed.

## 4. Report

Sections, in order: Executive Summary; Firewall Identity & Firmware; Interface & DNS Configuration; Subscription Services (TSS / GAV / IPS / etc.); Firewall Policies; BOVPN & Mobile VPN; Local User & Admin Audit; Recommended Actions; Data Gaps & Coverage Notes.

Thresholds: inspector_lastseen_days_max=1; license_expiration_warn_days=60; firmware_age_months_max=12; open_rdp_to_internet_allowed=False; wan_management_exposure_allowed=False; default_local_users_max=1.

Report each metric's actual value. Show "No data" for empty values; never mark a control passing without a supporting value. A "No data" row is a coverage gap only if the control matters and no other row covers it.

Coverage table: metrics fetched / required, with data / no data counts. Internal audience: add a verification log, one row per call (seq, metricId, result shape, status).

### Insights and recommendations

| Pattern | Recommendation template |
|---|---|
| Firmware out of date | "WatchGuard firmware <N> months old. Schedule upgrade to current Fireware OS." |
| TSS / subscription expiring | "Total Security Suite expires <N> days. Initiate renewal — without TSS, security services disable." |
| Specific service disabled | "<service> disabled. Confirm intent; re-enable per MSP baseline." |
| Open any-to-any policy | "URGENT: <N> any-to-any policies in policy list. Restrict per least-privilege." |
| WAN management exposed | "URGENT: Management on WAN allowed. Restrict to MSP IP allowlist or VPN-only." |
| RDP allowed inbound | "URGENT: Inbound RDP policy detected. Remove or restrict to VPN-only access." |
| BOVPN with weak crypto | "<N> BOVPN tunnels use deprecated Phase 1/2 encryption. Upgrade to AES-256 / SHA-256." |
| Mobile VPN with password-only auth | "<N> Mobile VPN users password-only. Enforce MFA via RADIUS + Authpoint or external IdP." |
| Default local admin enabled | "Default admin account present. Rename + rotate credential." |
| HA mismatch (standalone where pair expected) | "Firewall in Standalone mode; MSP standard is HA pair. Confirm intent." |
